messages:
claire: heads-up: after the overnight rollout (runtime 6.1.0 + SDK 8.2) warpnet-quant-slim is returning misaligned logits on chunked streams. small fraction (~0.25%) but reproducible. anyone else seeing this?

deploybot: Deploybot: anomaly detected: parse_misalignment=0.26% model=warpnet-quant-slim region=us-central at 03:02 UTC. No pins currently. (bot)

runtime_mira: saw the traces, appears when chunk boundary crosses a tensor-slice header introduced in runtime 6.1.0. header format v3 != v2 expected by older SDK serializers.

sdk_dev_juan: SDK 8.2 changed serializer to emit header_v3 for performance. we added a compat mode but left it off for newer models. can flip for pinned models.

infra_sam: suggestion: do an SDK soft-pin to 8.1.4 for warpnet-quant-slim in us-central and eu-central for 75m, keep a 5% canary on 8.2 to validate shim. avoids touching runtime.

claire: +1 to SDK pin. prefer SDK-level because less infra churn. release_czar can you sign off on the window and rollback criteria?

release_czar: approved for 75m. rollback criteria: if parse_misalignment >0.2% sustained for 15m in pinned regions -> escalate to full SDK rollback; if latency regresses >10% after pin, revert and consider runtime harmony patch. owners: sdk + runtime + infra.

deploybot: executing: `/deploybot pin-sdk --model warpnet-quant-slim --sdk 8.1.4 --regions us-central,eu-central --duration 75m --canary 5% --note "header_v3 incompat"`

deploybot: Pin applied at 8123456800 :white_check_mark:

sdk_dev_juan: I'll enable `compat.header_v2=true` for pinned models and open a micro-patch PR. will paste PR link here when ready.

runtime_mira: we'll add a defensive check in 6.1.x branch to reject header_v3 streams for models without explicit opt-in; patch ETA ~4h if needed.

infra_sam: monitoring dashboards now. initial delta: parse_misalignment down to 0.06% in us-central within 4m. eu-central trending 0.09%.

claire: drafted release blurb: "Temporary SDK pin to 8.1.4 for warpnet-quant-slim in us-central & eu-central due to chunk-header compatibility issue observed with SDK 8.2 + runtime 6.1.0. 75m soft-pin; 5% canary retained on 8.2. Owners: SDK & Runtime."

release_czar: keeping this thread live. opsbot will post automated summary on pin-lift or on escalation.

opsbot: Automated follow-up scheduled at 8123457155 or on earlier pin-lift. (bot)
